crosswalks.historical_boundary: Continental France within the modern-border demographic envelope used by Goldstone and Lot's 528,400 km2 reconstruction
crosswalks.resolution_method: Complete france_region selector intersected through calibrated EU5 geometry; the mapped lower-bound population is not inflated to cover the declared residual boundary area.
crosswalks.notes: Lower-bound aggregate validation only; cities and ports are not separate training labels.
